verses.text: Ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Leví: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Haxo winhaj Coat chi' chanhwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.

Ha winhaj Amram chi' chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés yet' jun yisil winh, haton ix María. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.

Haton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón tik sb'eyb'at t'a stzolal t'a heb' winh uninab'il yet' t'a heb' winh ichikinab'il: Winhaj Eleazar, winhaj Finees, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahimaas, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Azarías, (haton winh sacerdote yaj t'a templo ix sb'ok'e winhaj Salomón t'a Jerusalén), winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Salum, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Seraías yet' winhaj Josadac. Ha winhaj Josadac chi' ix ik'jib'at winh preso yet' heb' ay t'a Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo lugar t'a yol yik Judá yuj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor, yujto a Jehová ix ak'an sk'ulej winh icha chi'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Leví oxwanh heb': Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Haton winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Coat chi': Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari chi': Haton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Ha heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yinhtilal Leví heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Libni, winhaj Jahat, winhaj Zima, winhaj Joa, winhaj Iddo, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Jeatrai.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Aminadab, winhaj Coré, winhaj Asir, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Ebiasaf, winhaj Asir, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Uriel, winhaj Ozías yet' winhaj Saúl.

Haxo winhaj Elcana chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Amasai yet' winhaj Ahimot. Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Ahimot chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Elcana, winhaj Safai, winhaj Nahat, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Elcana yet' winhaj Samuel.
Haxo winhaj Samuel chi' chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Vasni sb'ab'el yuninal winh, schab'il winhaj Abías.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari t'a stzolal: Winhaj Mahli, winhaj Libni, winhaj Simei, winhaj Uza, winhaj Simea, winhaj Haguía yet' winhaj Asaías.
Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix ak'jioch yuj winhaj rey David yik sb'itan heb' winh t'a skajnub' Jehová, yiktax ix ak'jioch te' skaxail trato t'a yol skajnub' Jehová t'a Jerusalén.
T'a stzolal tz'aj yoch heb' winh sb'itan t'a yichanh kajnub' chi' masanto yik ix b'ojik'e stemplo Jehová yuj winhaj Salomón.

Ha heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio sb'itan chi' yet' heb' winh yuninal, haton sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Hemán skuchb'an jun makan heb' winh sb'itan chi'. Ha sb'i heb' winh b'aj ix kot yinhtilal winhaj Hemán chi' tz'el yich t'a winh smam winh masanto t'a slajwub'xo smam yicham winh, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Joel, winhaj Samuel, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Toa, winhaj Zuf, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Mahat, winhaj Amasai, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Joel, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Sofonías, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Asir, winhaj Ebiasaf, winhaj Coré, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Coat, winhaj Leví yet' winhaj Israel.

Ha t'a swach' winhaj Hemán chi' skan winhaj Asaf, haton winh skuchb'an junxo makan heb' winh sb'itan chi'. Haton sb'i heb' winh smam yicham winhaj Asaf chi' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Berequías, winhaj Simea, winhaj Micael, winhaj Baasías, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Etni, winhaj Zera, winhaj Adaía, winhaj Etán, winhaj Zima, winhaj Simei, winhaj Jahat, winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Leví.

Haxo t'a sk'exanh winhaj Hemán chi' skan heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari sb'itan paxi. Ha winhaj Etán skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi'. Haton stzolal smam yicham winhaj Etán tik: Winhaj Quisi, winhaj Abdi, winhaj Maluc, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Amsi, winhaj Bani, winhaj Semer, winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi, winhaj Merari yet' winhaj Leví.
Haxo juntzanh heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, hanheja' yinhtilal Leví heb' winh, ix kan heb' winh munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal, a heb' snhusan ofrenda t'a altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' t'a altar yik incienso. Hanhejtona' a heb' tz'ilan masanil opisio t'a jun Lugar Yiknhej Jehová yaji yet' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul heb' yetisraelal heb', icha wal yutejnak winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios yalankani.

Haton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Eleazar, winhaj Finees, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahimaas.

Haton juntzanh chonhab' tik yet' smakb'en b'aj ix kajnaj heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Ix och suerte t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat ix em jun b'ab'el makan, yuj chi' a chonhab' Hebrón t'a yol yik Judá, a ix kan t'a heb' winh yet' sluumal t'a spatiktak b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' winh. Palta a juntzanh yaldeail yet' sluumal t'a spatiktak chi' ak'b'il t'a winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' ix ak'chaj Hebrón, haton jun chonhab' chi' b'aj syal skolan sb'a heb' smilancham junok anima manh sk'anok sk'ool. Ix ak'jipax juntzanhxo chonhab' tik t'a heb': Libna, Jatir, Estemoa, Hilén, Debir, Asán yet' Bet-semes. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', ha t'a yol yik Judá ay. Haxo t'a yol yik Benjamín ix ak'chaj juntzanhxo chonhab' tik: Geba, Alemet yet' Anatot. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', 13 t'a smasanil, ix kannhej yet' sluumal t'a spatiktak b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Yet' t'a smakb'en yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix ak'chajpax lajunhexo chonhab' t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat chi'.

Haxo pax t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, icha jay makan yaj heb', 13 chonhab' ix ak'chaj t'a heb'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Isacar, heb' yik Aser, heb' yik Neftalí yet' t'a yik heb' Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton t'a Basán.

Hanheja' pax t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, ix ak'chaj 12 chonhab' icha jay makan yaj heb'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', ha t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Rubén ay, heb' yik Gad yet' heb' yik Zabulón.
Ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' chi' t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví yuj heb' yetisraelal yet' pax b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a spatiktak juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ha t'a smakb'en Judá, yik Simeón yet' yik Benjamín, hata' ay juntzanh chonhab' toxo ix b'inaj ix ak'chaj t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví chi', icha ix aj yik'an heb' t'a suerteal.
Ay juntzanhxo makan yinhtilal winhaj Coat ix chaan juntzanh chonhab' b'aj tz'aj heb' t'a smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Efraín:
Haton Siquem t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín chi', haton t'a jun chonhab' chi' syal skolan sb'a heb' smilancham junok anima to manh sk'anok sk'ool. Ix yik'anpax juntzanh chonhab' tik heb': Gezer,
Jocmeam, Bet-horón, Ajalón yet' Gat-rimón. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yik' heb' yet' b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Yet' t'a smakb'en yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix schapax chonhab' Aner yet' Bileam heb' yet' pax b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, icha syal jay makan yaj heb', ix ak'chaj chonhab' Golán t'a yol yik Basán, chonhab' Astarot yet' b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Ha chab' chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en Manasés t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ix ak'chajpax juntzanhxo chonhab' tik t'a heb' t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Isacar: Cedes, Daberat, Ramot yet' Anem. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ix ak'chajpax juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a heb' t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Aser: Masal, Abdón, Hucoc yet' Rehob. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Cedes t'a yol yik Galilea, Hamón yet' Quiriataim. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' t'a heb' t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Zabulón: Rimón yet' Tabor. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Rubén t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán, t'a yichanhb'at Jericó, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Beser t'a jun ak'lik tzinan lu'um, Jaza, Cademot yet' Mefaat. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Gad, ix ak'chajpax juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, Mahanaim, Hesbón yet' Jazer. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
